profile.hand.hint: For left-handed golfers the video is mirrored before analysis.
profile.height.hint: Used to estimate body size when the mat is hard to see.
profile.club_length.hint: A typical length is filled in when you change club; you can enter your own.
venues.hint: Measure a new venue, rename, delete or set the default
theme.hint: Sun is a high-contrast look with thick borders for direct sunlight.
text_size.hint: Text size follows your iPhone's Settings › Display & Brightness › Text Size.
live.metrics.hint: Choose up to 3. Numbers the mode cannot measure are not shown.
live.metrics.max: 3 chosen: remove one before choosing another
live.voice.hint: Speaks the result after each swing, so you don't have to look at the phone.
diag.hint: Device and error records you can attach to a problem report
storage.title: Storage & backup
storage.unknown: This browser does not report how much space is used.
storage.no_repo: Storage is unavailable: results from this visit will not be saved.
storage.low: Space is running low. New practice sessions may not be able to keep their videos.
storage.over: Storage use is above the recommended limit. Clean up old videos or back up first.
storage.persisted: Protected: the browser will not delete this data automatically.
storage.evict.title: Add to Home Screen and protect your data
storage.evict.body: If the app is not opened for a while, iPhone may delete website data. Add the app to your Home Screen, then tap Protect my data; please also back up regularly.
storage.persist.ok: The browser will keep your data
storage.persist.denied: The browser said no. Add the app to your Home Screen and try again.
storage.cleanup.title: Clean up old videos
storage.cleanup.body: When space runs low you can delete the oldest original videos. The numbers and poses of every swing are kept, and starred videos are never deleted.
storage.cleanup.none: There is enough space; nothing to clean up
storage.cleanup.not_enough: Even deleting every video that can go is not enough: back up first, then delete swings you don't need in History.
storage.cleanup.confirm.body: Deletes the {n} oldest original videos without a star and frees about {size}. Numbers and poses are kept, but you will no longer be able to watch these swings.
storage.cleanup.failed: Nothing was deleted. Please try again
storage.backup.hint: History can save all your data as one file, or restore it from one
dev.title: Developer options

dev.taps.one: {n} more tap to turn on developer options
dev.taps.other: {n} more taps to turn on developer options

dev.enabled: Developer options are on: at the bottom of Settings
dev.model.title: Swing phase detection
dev.model.bundled: Using the model included in this version.
dev.model.no_rollback: There is no previous model to go back to.
dev.model.need_both: Choose both the description file and the weights file
dev.model.bad_json: The description file is not valid JSON
dev.model.imported_ok: Imported {version}. The previous model is kept so you can go back.
dev.model.import_failed: The import failed. Please try again
dev.model.rollback: Go back to the previous model
dev.model.no_repo: Storage is unavailable, so a model cannot be saved
dev.model.hint: Before importing, the file fingerprint, feature version and weight shapes are checked; when the description includes reference outputs, the model's results are compared too.
dev.health.title: Calibration check-up
dev.health.shots: {n} swings since the last check-up (reminder every {limit})
dev.health.drop_never: No ball-drop test yet. Once a month is recommended.
dev.health.hint: If the mat size works out more than 1% different, you are asked whether the mat changed; if the brightness differs from calibration by more than 30%, you are reminded and the background is rebuilt.
dev.pose.title: Pose model (for imported videos)
dev.pose.hint: Live mode always uses Fast. Detailed is the most accurate but takes longer per video.
dev.pose.heavy.offline: No connection: connect to the internet to download it
dev.pose.downloaded: The detailed model is downloaded and works offline.
dev.pose.download_failed: The download failed. Please try again later
dev.setup.title: Setup details
dev.setup.body: While developer options are on, the setup screens show raw calibration numbers and a timer for each step.
dev.spec.label: Show spec codes
dev.spec.hint: Shows internal spec numbers next to screen elements, to match problem reports with the documentation.
